description: Detect classic candlestick patterns on a ticker's recent daily bars: hammer, inverted hammer, bullish/bearish engulfing, doji, morning/evening star, and shooting star. Returns each detected pattern with {pattern, date, direction (bullish/bearish/neutral), barIndex}. HEURISTIC pattern detection with conservative default thresholds; for research, not investment advice.

lookback_days.description: Trailing daily bars to scan for patterns (default 60).

name: candlestick_signals
